# NoLock.onAcquire() method

Registers nothing: [NoLock.acquire()](/api/pg-pubsub/latest/pg-pubsub.nolock.acquire/) always succeeds immediately, so there is no late takeover for the handler to report.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onAcquire(handler: (channel: string) => void): void;
```
